🇻🇳 Ho Chi Minh City claims rank #90 in the 2026 GMPI Top 100!

The "Dragon of the South" (formerly Saigon) edges out Manila to crack the top 90. It is the undisputed economic engine of Vietnam and the primary beneficiary of the global supply chain shift away from China.

GMPI Score Card:

💰 Economy: 50/100 - The "New Factory of the World." HCMC is a magnet for massive FDI (Samsung, Intel). Unlike the service-based economy of Manila, HCMC is built on hard manufacturing and exports, giving it a solid foundation for rapid GDP growth.

🏗️ Infrastructure: 30/100 - The "Sea of Motorbikes." Public transport is still in its infancy. While the long-awaited Metro Line 1 is a game-changer, the city struggles with severe congestion and, critically, rising sea levels that threaten its foundations.

📈 Finance: 35/100 - Home to the HOSE (Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange). It is the financial heart of the country, rapidly professionalizing and becoming a hotspot for Southeast Asian fintech and venture capital.

🏛️ Politics: 35/100 - While Hanoi holds the political power, HCMC holds the purse strings. It contributes the lion's share to the national budget, granting it significant leverage, though it remains under strict central oversight.

🎓 Prestige: 40/100 - A city of electric energy. Famous for its world-class street food culture and the towering Landmark 81 (pictured). It offers a unique blend of French colonial history and futuristic ambition.
